title: Surat cyber crime branch arrests four in Madhya Pradesh over APK fraud on elderly Gujarat man
date_note: The page gives only its publication day; the arrest day is not stated.
geo_basis: Surat City Cyber Crime Branch, as the source states
summary: The Surat City Cyber Crime Branch arrested four people in Morena district, Madhya Pradesh, over UPI transfers taken without the knowledge of an elderly Gujarat man, as reported by prokerala. Police said the victim found four unknown APK files on his phone, which they suspect were used to access it or his banking apps, and that the accused lent bank accounts for commissions.
plain: Police in Surat arrested four people in Madhya Pradesh over money taken from an elderly man's accounts after unknown APK apps were found on his phone.
exec: Police say fraud networks use lent bank accounts and unknown APK files to move money from victims.
action: Surat police advise not to install APKs from unknown links, not to lend bank accounts or banking phones for money, and to call 1930 quickly to help freeze funds.

validation.note: Two publishers read (prokerala, The420.in), each stating the four arrests in Morena and the four APK files; New Indian Express page not loaded.
